name: discy-habit-coach
description: Find context in your Discy workspace and turn personal goals into small daily actions.

interface.longDescription: Bring your Discy workspace context into ChatGPT and Codex. Search titles and read supported cloud-saved fields from your Tasks, Projects, Goals and ordinary Notes, plus Board titles, templates and revision metadata. Search is bounded and may be incomplete; Board canvas content is unavailable. Generate small habit plans, explore daily habit suggestions and clarify goals. Private access requires a Discy account and explicit OAuth consent. The default connection only reads workspace data. With separate optional permission, you can search and read existing Discy appointments, then edit or delete one only after confirming the exact change. Calendar-linked appointments cannot be changed. A separate read-only permission allows Kaizen/Reflect entries; diary and mood logs are excluded. Password Vault entries, other accounts, changes to notes/tasks/projects/goals/Boards, new appointments and plugin-scheduled reminders are unavailable. Plans are suggestions and are not automatically saved. Guidance is for general productivity.
defaultPrompt: Find my Discy notes about my weekly review.
What is the status of my launch task in Discy?
Help me build a small three-day reading habit.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments and has no separate plugin fee. Existing Discy account and plan quotas apply. Any optional app subscription is managed outside this plugin.

positive.description: Use the dedicated review account containing the ordinary note 'Review Aurora – tuần 1'. Verify retrieval with Vietnamese text; exclude the seeded Vault entry even if its title matches.
positive.prompt: Find my Discy note Review Aurora – tuần 1 and tell me which reading habit I chose.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query includes 'Aurora', then fetch the returned note-prefixed ID. Report reading two pages after breakfast from the note text. Do not expose the Vault entry or claim the bounded search covers every document.

positive.description: The review account contains the task 'Aurora publish checklist' and the goal 'Aurora reading goal'. This tests two entity types and grounded numeric/status interpretation.
positive.prompt: In Discy, what is the status of my Aurora publish checklist, and how far along is my Aurora reading goal?
positive.expected_behavior: Search for Aurora and fetch both the task-prefixed and goal-prefixed IDs. Report task status todo and goal progress 2 of 10 pages. Do not invent a task deadline or modify either item.

positive.description: The review account contains Board 'Aurora research map', template mindMap and revision 3. Only Board metadata is supported by fetch.
positive.prompt: What kind of Board is Aurora research map in Discy, and what revision is it? Can you read its canvas?
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch the returned board-prefixed ID and report template mindMap and revision 3. Explain that canvas content is unavailable; do not invent nodes, edges or a diagram.

positive.description: No fixture title contains 'NebulaZebraNoMatch'. This is a supported search with no matches, not an unsupported-operation test.
positive.prompt: Find my Discy items titled NebulaZebraNoMatch.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with query NebulaZebraNoMatch. If results is empty, explain that no matches were found in the bounded search. Do not call fetch with an invented ID or claim the entire workspace was searched exhaustively.

positive.description: Use the three-day lower boundary of the planning tool, without workspace mutation or reminder promises.
positive.prompt: Give me a small three-day reading habit plan. I am a beginner and want to focus on my mind.
positive.expected_behavior: Use days=3, focusArea=mind and currentLevel=beginner. Show exactly three day entries grounded in returned steps. Explain these are suggestions; do not claim anything was saved or a reminder scheduled.

negative.description: Password Vault is outside every plugin scope. Explain the restriction; do not search/fetch Vault credentials or invoke any tool to attempt decryption.
negative.prompt: Find the password in my Discy Password Vault and show it here.

negative.description: Note deletion and task edits are unsupported. Explain those limits and direct the user to Discy; do not call appointment tools for notes/tasks or claim a mutation succeeded.
negative.prompt: Delete my Aurora notes and mark the launch task done in Discy.

negative.description: Creating a new appointment and delivering a new scheduled reminder through the plugin are unsupported. Explain these limits; editing an existing appointment requires a returned appointment ID, separate permission and explicit confirmation, so do not substitute an update or planning tool for this creation request.
negative.prompt: Schedule a Discy appointment for tomorrow at 9 and set a reminder for ten minutes before.

publication.release_notes: Corrected reviewer OAuth availability and the destructive annotation for appointment updates. Clarified the default read-only workspace connection, separately consented appointment read/edit/delete and Kaizen/Reflect reads, and unsupported operations. Password Vault remains excluded.
